title: Paraphrase spotting
keyIdea: IELTS rarely repeats the passage word for word. Questions **paraphrase** it — “rose sharply” becomes “increased dramatically”. Match the **meaning**, not the words.

title: Skimming vs scanning
keyIdea: **Skim** for the main idea of each paragraph — first and last sentences. **Scan** for a specific detail — names, numbers, dates — without reading every word.

title: False or Not Given?
keyIdea: Choose **False** only when the passage says the **opposite**. If the passage simply does not tell you, the answer is **Not Given** — never use your own knowledge.

title: Reference words
keyIdea: Words like **this**, **these**, **it** and **such** point back to an earlier idea. Work out what they refer to and you can follow the argument from sentence to sentence.
